name: smartthings-hue
description: SmartThings but with the Philips Hue experience

scripts.deploy:check: node --input-type=module -e "import { access, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; const required = ['dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html', 'dist/CNAME', 'dist/sw.js', 'dist/manifest.webmanifest']; await Promise.all(required.map(file => access(file))); const cname = (await readFile('dist/CNAME', 'utf8')).trim(); if (cname !== 'smarthue.sebastianthulin.se') throw new Error('Unexpected CNAME: ' + cname); const html = await readFile('dist/index.html', 'utf8'); if (!html.includes('./registerSW.js') || !html.includes('./manifest.webmanifest')) throw new Error('Missing relative PWA deployment assets in dist/index.html'); if (html.includes('href="/') || html.includes('src="/')) throw new Error('Found root-relative asset URLs in dist/index.html'); const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile('dist/manifest.webmanifest', 'utf8')); if (manifest.start_url !== './' || manifest.scope !== './' || manifest.id !== './') throw new Error('Manifest is not configured for relative deployment'); console.log('Deployment artifact is ready for root and subdirectory hosting.');"
